name: createAlarm
description: Create an alarm for a task. The alarm will notify the user at the specified time. Returns the alarm ID, or null if exact alarms are not permitted on this device.

parameters.name: currentAlarmId
parameters.description: The existing alarm ID to update, or null to create a new alarm

parameters.name: dueDate
parameters.description: The time for the alarm in epoch milliseconds. Use formatDate to convert if needed.
